body: Multimodal LLMs are typically trained by first aligning a vision encoder with a language model via projector training on large image-caption datasets, followed by joint training of the full multimodal model. Despite its widespread use, the role of the projector training stage remains poorly understood. We find that (i) using only 10 to 20% of the data for training the projector already recovers most downstream performance gains, and (ii) projectors trained on different datasets can be linearly interpolated while largely preserving performance. These results suggest that projector training mainly performs a coarse alignment, which many different projectors achieve equally well. Motivated by these findings, we propose PORTAL, a training-free projector initialization that requires neither paired image-caption data nor gradient-based optimization, but only per-modality summary statistics. PORTAL computes an optimal-transport-based map between Gaussian approximations of the vision and language feature distributions on a shared principal subspace, so that the projector training stage can be skipped entirely. Without any paired data, PORTAL matches the standard pipeline trained on 558k image-caption pairs across six LLM backbones, two vision encoders, and 16 benchmarks. It outperforms that pipeline in 3 of 7 (vision encoder, LLM) settings and reaches an average 98% of its score across the other four.
summaryZh: 多模态大模型通常先通过在大规模图像-文本数据集上训练投影层来对齐视觉编码器与语言模型。本文发现仅使用10%至20%的数据即可恢复大部分下游性能收益，且不同数据集训练的投影层可进行线性插值。受此启发，本文提出了PORTAL，一种无需配对图像-文本数据或基于梯度优化的训练免初始化方法。它计算特征分布的最优传输映射，无需投影训练阶段即可在多项基准测试中匹配传统流程。

aiReview.reasonZh: 揭示了多模态大模型中投影层预训练阶段的冗余性，并提出免训练的PORTAL初始化方法，大幅降低了多模态模型对齐的训练成本。

glossary.explanationZh: 投影层训练，多模态大模型中用于对齐视觉编码器和语言模型特征空间的中间适配层训练阶段。
线性插值，在两组模型参数或特征之间按比例平滑过渡计算的方法。
最优传输，一种数学理论与计算方法，用于寻找将一个概率分布变换为另一个分布的最低成本方案。
高斯近似，使用正态分布来近似复杂特征分布的统计学方法。
